name: Bitch Squad
source:
You have just graduated high school after a very difficult Senior year. Your life was made a living hell for a year because of a group of popular rich girls who seemingly ran the school and persecuted those who didn't worship them. After getting into a local school, you think that you are finally free and are looking to start a new life. But you are shocked to find that members of this same girls group have started attending your new school as well.

Why is a mystery to, but it doesn't take long to realize that they are positioning themsevles in the same way as in high school. Unable to transfer and unwilling to live through the suffering again, you and your friends attempt to stop them this time and prevent their rise to power, if they can.

[From Patreon]
translation:
在经历了非常困难的高三之后，你刚刚高中毕业。你的生活在一年内变得人间地狱，因为一群受欢迎的富家女孩似乎经营着学校并迫害那些不崇拜她们的人。进入当地学校后，你认为自己终于自由了，并希望开始新的生活。但你惊讶地发现这个女子团体的成员也开始在你的新学校上学。

为什么是个谜，但没过多久我们就意识到他们正在以与高中时相同的方式定位自己。由于无法转移，也不愿再次经历痛苦，你和你的朋友这次试图阻止他们，并尽可能阻止他们掌权。

[来自帕特伦]
